top_signals.title: Officials Work to Speed Grid Connection Amid Data Center Buildout
top_signals.summary:
Data-center developers are increasingly turning to so-called behind-the-meter power generation to bypass years-long waits for grid connections and get their facilities running sooner.
Ed Hirs, Energy Fellow at the University of Houston, discusses the energy sector, growing need for data-center power, and what government officials in Texas, and around the US, are doing about it. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Microsoft Patches More Than 1,400 Security Flaws
top_signals.summary: Microsoft today issued updates to fix more than 1,400 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and other software. Today's epic patch batch dwarfs September's record of nearly 1,000 fixes, which was already about ten times the normal monthly patch load from Redmond.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
